item.title: South Carolina Defeats Texas A&M Behind 5th Joyce Edwards Double-Double

item.title: Black History Month Spotlight: USA Bobsled Legend Vonetta Flowers
item.description: US bobsledder Vonetta Flowers broke winter sports barriers, becoming the first-ever Black athlete to win Olympic gold at the 2022 Salt Lake City Games. The post Black History Month Spotlight: USA Bobsled Legend Vonetta Flowers appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
